column3: “the men of Ephraim” renders the collective “the man of Ephraim”; “vigorously” renders “with force.”
“the gleaning of the grapes” renders “the gleanings.”
“the men of Succoth” renders “the people of Succoth”; “who are following me” renders “at my feet.”
“What kind of men were they” renders “Where are the men”; “each one resembling” renders “one like the appearance of.”
“the men of Israel” renders the collective “the man of Israel.”
NASB puts “For they had gold earrings … Ishmaelites” in parentheses.
“played the harlot with it” renders “acted as prostitutes after it.”
“his direct descendants” renders “who came out of his thigh.”
